data.one_liner: Fine-grained reactive state management library for Flutter using signals.
data.what_it_does: Provides fine-grained reactivity and surgical widget rendering based on Preact Signals. Automatically tracks dependencies and only computes or re-renders parts of the UI that change.
use_when: You want fine-grained reactivity without explicit state management boilerplate
You want optimal UI rebuilds targeting only the specific widgets that depend on updated signals
avoid_when: You prefer structured architectural patterns like BLoC or Riverpod
Your project relies on legacy state patterns that have been deprecated in this library
weaknesses: Frequent breaking changes and deprecations across recent major versions
Documentation depends heavily on external website resources

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: More robust and widely adopted reactive state management solution in the Flutter ecosystem.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides strict predictability and separation of concerns through events and states.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler and more traditional inherited widget wrapper approach.
